steps.en: Clone the template, copy the env file and install
steps.zh: 克隆模板，复制 env 文件并安装依赖

steps.en: Connect a CopilotKit Intelligence project and add a model key
steps.zh: 接上 Intelligence 项目，填模型密钥

steps.en: Brings up Postgres, migrations, API, app and bots; serves localhost:3010
steps.zh: 拉起数据库、迁移、API、前端和机器人，开在 3010

steps.en: Write a deny rule for browser/file/MCP actions
steps.zh: 为浏览器／文件／MCP 动作写一条拒绝规则

steps.en: Ask a coworker to do a task on the web
steps.zh: 让一个同事去网上办件事
steps.code: Open news.ycombinator.com and tell me the top story.

steps.en: Checks each tool call against the policy, writes an audit row, then drives the bot's own browser
steps.zh: 每个调用先查策略、写审计，再驱动它自己的浏览器

value.en: Agents act in real web apps for your staff, and you stop taking their word for it — every action was policy-checked first and is on the record
value.zh: agent 替员工操作真实网页应用，而你不必再靠它自述做了什么——每个动作都先过策略、全部留档
